interface.name: easi_files_v1

description.summary: files between the person and the browser

interface.description: Offered only to the browser container's own launcher, on the browser's Wayland socket, and bound at most once per display: files move as descriptors, so the display never opens a path the browser can write. A download streams in on one end of a Unix stream socket pair the launcher writes as the browser writes the file (the display only ever reads it without blocking); uploads come in as pipes the launcher drains into its own private directory. Every request and event belongs to the current control lease: the display drops what a lease change makes stale.

request.name: start_download
request.description: A download the launcher numbered `id`: its bytes arrive in order on `data` (one end of a Unix stream socket pair) as the browser writes them, and the stream ends with end_download or fail_download. The display offers it to the person holding control, and answers reading once someone receives it or stop_download when it will read no more. `known` says whether the browser knows its size (then exactly `size_hi`:`size_lo` bytes, or it fails); the display offers it with that size.

request.name: end_download

description.summary: every byte of a download was written to its socket

request.description: The browser finished the download; it is exactly this size, and the socket was closed after its last byte.

request.name: fail_download
request.description: The browser cancelled it, or wrote it in a way the launcher could not follow (it restarted the file): the person's download must fail rather than complete.

request.name: open_chooser

description.summary: the page opened a file chooser

request.description: The page asked for files (through the file chooser portal); the display asks the person holding control. Answered by chosen events and then chooser_done, or by chooser_cancelled.

request.name: close_chooser

description.summary: the page gave up on the chooser

request.description: Chromium closed its request: the display stops asking the person, and nothing more is sent for this chooser.

request.name: stored
request.description: The launcher wrote all of an upload's bytes, exactly its size, to path (in its private uploads directory).

description.summary: an upload could not be stored

request.name: page_opened
request.description: Whether the browser opened request `request`'s page (1) or not (0): the launcher answers every open_page once.

event.name: reading
event.description: The person holding control started receiving it: the launcher holds the browser back while they fall behind.

event.name: stop_download

description.summary: the display reads no more of the download

event.description: It was refused, cancelled, or abandoned; the launcher discards the rest of it.

event.name: upload
event.description: A file the person is giving the page, whose bytes arrive on the pipe until it closes; the launcher answers stored (all of its size arrived) or failed.

event.name: chosen

description.summary: a file the person chose for the chooser

event.description: The path the launcher stored an upload at, chosen for this chooser.

event.name: chooser_done
event.description: Every chosen file was sent; the portal answers with them.

description.summary: no files: the person cancelled, or nobody holds control

event.name: open_page

description.summary: open a page in place of every page the browser shows

event.description: For the current lease holder, at the admin's request (a public demo's page): the launcher opens `url` (https) in a new tab and, once the browser made it, closes every other tab. Answered with page_opened.
